description: Cube-Series Outdoor Home Sauna Suite Kit, Up to 8 Persons Experience the pinnacle of comfort, luxury, and wellness with the SaunaLife Cube-Series Model CL12GCP sauna kit. This is a true sauna suite, complete with a separate dressing room, a cozy sauna with a picture window, and uncompromised comfort for up to 8 bathers. Sauna suite complete with sauna & separate dressing room Large tempered-glass picture window in sauna Robust Thermo-Spruce exterior with thick 12.5-foot full-length staves Engineered for superior airflow and circulation Contoured, silky-smooth Thermo-Aspen benches & backrests Designed to withstand extreme weather conditions Engineered to be the Best The SaunaLife CL12GCP outdoor DIY sauna suite is the pinnacle of the SaunaLife Cube Luxury Series. A charming front porch with seating and an integrated dressing room welcomes you and your family or guests into this haven of luxury and wellness. An expansive, bronze, tempered-glass picture window accentuates the spaciousness of the sauna room, creating a more accommodating environment. The CL12GCP is perfect for large properties and cabins where a changing room is an essential convenience. Unrivaled Comfort Every detail was considered to ensure exceptional comfort, including contoured seating surfaces and supportive arched backrests, so you’ll be comfortable even after long sauna sessions. Satin-smooth Thermo-Aspen seating provides cool-to-the-touch surfaces to ensure that you will have a relaxing and enjoyable sauna experience. Robust Construction Premium quality materials are evident everywhere on the CL12GCP Cube Luxury Sauna. The exterior wood is made from extra-thick, 12.5’ full-length staves which have been thermally enhanced organically for improved performance. Thermo-Spruce wood is much stronger, more dimensionally stable, naturally resists decay and pests, and will far outlast conventional wood. A complete shingle kit with drip rails ensures superior water management and a dry interior. Massive Framed Wood Front Door with Tempered Glass This exceptionally well-made front door features thick, laminated solid wood, thick bronze tempered glass, fully adjustable hinges, and a premium-quality security lock. This substantial door will provide years of reliable operation, safety, and protection from the elements. Premium Experience Enhancements Gently illuminating this spectacular sauna is app-based, Wi-Fi controlled premium “dotless” LED lighting. The elegant indirect lighting brings out the natural beauty of the wood and adds another dimension to your relaxing sauna. The CL12G Black includes outdoor black paint for customer application after delivery. The paint is recommended to be reapplied annually as needed to maintain the finish. Applying the paint after delivery allows for a smooth, even finish and helps avoid scratches or nicks that can occur during LTL freight shipping. If you do not receive tracking information from us within six business days of your order, feel free to follow up with us at customercare@nordicasauna.com . No shipping outside the lower 48 States in the USA. What if my shipment is damaged? Please inspect the packaging of your item(s) when they arrive. If your item(s) do arrive damaged please send photos to customercare@nordicasauna.com and we will process an insurance claim on your behalf. Your warranty will guarantee you a fully functional and operational product. If it is unclear whether your order is custom or made to order, please message or call us.
